title: Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence
breadcrumb: Solutions > Workforce & Experience > Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence
meta_description: Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence — composed architecture, platform stack and the metric the program answers to.

blocks.x: Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence exists because a specific failure keeps repeating: skills live in resumes and manager heads; workforce planning is headcount arithmetic; internal mobility blocked by invisible skills; learning spend unmeasured.
Skills live in resumes and manager heads; workforce planning is headcount arithmetic; internal mobility blocked by invisible skills; learning spend unmeasured.

The failure Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence answers is structural, not personal: processes that grew by accretion now decide things faster than they can be checked. Engineering the path is cheaper than hiring around it.
We build the skills graph: HRIS/LMS/performance data unified to a taxonomy, role/skill gap analytics feeding hiring and mobility, learning pathways wired to gaps, and evidence of capability transfer.

items: role/current-state gaps by unit and future need

blocks.note: Components and platforms are the named pieces of this solution, drawn in their architectural position.

blocks.x: Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence composes EEMS Platform, Driisti Smart Vision Glasses — platforms with documented controls and evidence packs, so governance is part of the runtime. The pattern is in delivery now in Technology & SaaS, Banking & Financial Services, Education & Research, Healthcare & Life Sciences.

Method over magic in Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence: the problem gets a CFO-unit statement and a signed baseline; the design gets a written risk envelope; the pilot gets falsifiable criteria; the rollout gets whatever the evidence supports. Every artifact ships with its evidence — who signed the baseline, what the gate measured, where the number lives.
The Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence value case names what should move and by what mechanism. The numbers get filled in from your baseline, not from a brochure.
Bring Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence to a 45-minute briefing with the practice lead — your metric, our method, and an honest read on feasibility.
